source_excerpts.title: Fitting-minor certificates for honest change of characteristic
source_excerpts.mechanism: A Macaulay matrix over Z has a rational rank; a nonzero maximal minor certifies the same lower rank outside its prime divisors, while larger minors vanish identically. The module cokernel and its Fitting ideals localize torsion. A Boolean quotient is not merely a characteristic specialization of an arbitrary prime-field digit presentation, so an explicit common integral model is mandatory. Where no common model exists, the transfer statement is unavailable. Where it exists, characteristic-specific torsion becomes a reusable positive resource for understanding why a degree deficit appears only in one field.
